pages.en:
“In any case, Zouken had some purpose for Saber herself.

“He must have wanted you kept alive as her Master. But quite apart from that, he also had a reason to kill you.

“…I'll ask you one more time. You're certain he said you had served your purpose?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Anyway. Zouken had something he wanted out of Saber.
He probably wanted you to stay alive as a Master. But with that aside, he had a reason to kill you.
…I’ll ask again. You’re sure that he said you’re useless, right?”

pages.ja:

小僧、おまえは用済みよ
」

“The Tohsaka girl still has some value to me.

“But you, boy, have served your purpose—”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“There are still uses for the daughter of Tohsaka.
But you are of no more use
”

pages.en:
“…Yeah. He also said you were still of some use to him.”

“I see. …I have no idea what that part means, but it explains why he keeps avoiding me.

“If we meet, one of us will have to die. But Zouken wants us both alive for now, so he's gone into hiding to make sure we don't encounter each other—”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Yeah. And he also said you’re still useful.”
“I see. …I don’t know why you’re useless now, but that must be why he’s running away from me.
One of us has to die if we meet. But Zouken needs both of us to stay alive for some reason, so he’s hiding from me
”
